tool_description: This recipe API allows users to search for recipes by ingredient. It returns a JSON response with the matching recipes, including the name, list of ingredients, and instructions.
name: Recipe Finder

api_list.name: icecream/ingredient
api_list.description: This API endpoint allows users to retrieve a random icecream recipe that contains a specific ingredient. Users can make a GET request to the endpoint with the name of the ingredient as a query parameter, and the API will return a JSON response with the given recipe, including the name, list of ingredients, and instructions.

test_endpoint.name: Blueberry Ice Cream
instructions: 1. Combine blueberries and sugar in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Cook, stirring frequently, until sugar is dissolved and blueberries are soft, about 5 minutes.
2. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. Transfer to a blender and puree until smooth.
3. Pour mixture into a large bowl. Stir in milk, cream, and vanilla extract.
4. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight.
5. Freeze mixture in an ice cream maker according to manufacturer's instructions. Serve immediately, or store in the freezer for later.

test_endpoint.name: Lime Cake
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease and flour two 8-inch round baking pans.
2. In large bowl, cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs, one at a time, then lime juice and peel.

3. In another bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Add to butter mixture alternately with buttermilk, beginning and ending with flour mixture. Divide batter evenly between pans.
4. Bake for 28 to 32 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pans on wire racks for 10 minutes. Remove from pans; cool completely on wire racks.
5. Frost as desired.

test_endpoint.name: Strawberry Tart
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
2. On a lightly floured surface, roll pastry to a 1/8-in.-thick (3-mm-) sheet. Trim even with edge of pan.
3. Line pan with pastry. Trim pastry even with edge of pan. Prick pastry several times with fork. Bake for 8 minutes. Cool on a wire rack.
4. In a small bowl, whisk together egg, sugar, cornstarch, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt.
5. Arrange strawberries over crust. Spoon jam over strawberries. Pour egg mixture over jam.
6. Bake for 20 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) and bake for 20 minutes longer.
7. Cool on a wire rack.

test_endpoint.name: Roasted Parmesan Garlic Potatoes
ingredients: -1 1/2 pounds small Yukon Gold potatoes, halved
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees F.
2. Toss the potatoes with the olive oil, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
3. Spread the potatoes in a single layer on a baking sheet.
4. Roast for 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and golden brown.
5. Remove from the oven and toss with the Parmesan cheese and garlic. Serve warm.

test_endpoint.name: Cucumber and Dill Salad
ingredients: 1 English cucumber, sliced into thin rounds
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine the cucumber, red onion, dill pickles, fresh dill, mayonnaise, sour cream, vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper.
2. Toss to combine.

test_endpoint.name: Omelette:
instructions: 1. In a bowl, whisk together eggs and milk.
2. In a large skillet over medium heat, melt butter. Add egg mixture and cook, stirring occasionally, until eggs are firm and cooked through.
3. Add cheese, salt, and pepper, and fold omelette in half. Serve immediately.

test_endpoint.name: Chicken Teriyaki
ingredients: -1 lb chicken breast, cut into small strips
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, honey, vegetable oil, garlic, ginger, pineapple juice, and chicken broth.
2. Add chicken strips to the bowl and coat evenly with the marinade. Let sit for at least 30 minutes.
3. Preheat a grill or grill pan over medium-high heat.
4. Grill chicken strips for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
5. Serve with diced pineapple and enjoy!

test_endpoint.name: Ingredients:
ingredients: 1 pound fish fillets (such as cod, halibut, or salmon)
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
2. Sprinkle fish fillets with oregano, thyme, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Dredge in flour.
3. Heat olive oil in a large ovenproof skillet over high heat. Add fish fillets and cook for 1 minute per side.
4. Add white wine and chicken broth to the skillet. Place lemon slices on top of the fish.
5. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.

test_endpoint.name: Buffalo Chicken Dip:
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
2. In a bowl, mix together chicken, hot sauce, blue cheese dressing, ranch dressing, and cheddar cheese.
3. Spread mixture into a baking dish.
4. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until heated through and cheese is melted.
5. Serve with celery sticks, carrot sticks, or crackers.

test_endpoint.name: Hawaiian Haystacks
ingredients: -1 lb. pork tenderloin, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: 1. In a large skillet over medium-high heat, cook the pork in the olive oil until browned.
2. Add the pineapple, coconut milk, cornstarch, curry powder, salt, and pepper to the skillet, and stir until well combined.
3. Bring the mixture to a boil, and then reduce the heat to low and let simmer for about 5 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
4. Serve the pork over the cooked rice, and top with the green onions.

test_endpoint.name: Ham and Cheese Frittata
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, salt, and pepper.
3. In a large oven-proof skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add ham, onion, and bell pepper. Cook until vegetables are soft, about 5 minutes.
4. Pour in egg mixture and sprinkle with cheese. Cook until frittata is set and cheese is melted, about 5 minutes.
5. Place skillet in oven and bake until frittata is firm and golden brown, about 10 minutes.
6. Cut into wedges and serve.
